event_name: Date 05 October 2018 Time 12:51 2018 JAPANESE GRAND PRIX 04 - 07 October 2018 The Stewards, having received information from Renault Sport Formula One Team in relation to the team personnel who are associated with the running of the cars being within the confines of the circuit during the curfew period, as detailed in document 6, decide that in accordance with Article 11.9.1 read with 11.9.2a of the FIA International Sporting Code, and having regard to the fact that this was due to circumstances outside the control of the team, that this should not count as one of the two individual exemptions permitted during the 2018 Formula One championship.
title: Doc 11 2018 Japanese Grand Prix Decision Renault Curfew
